items.description:
Astram Technologies (PTY) Ltd, based in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, develops ASTRAM, a cloud-based quality management and inspection reporting platform aimed at inspection companies, asset managers and industrial operators in South Africa, India and Germany. The platform links inspection, asset and financial operations through sixteen connected modules so that a field finding can flow through to a report, repair job and invoice.

Its Dashboard module gives real-time KPIs across inspection status, asset health, open jobs and financial summaries, while Asset Management tracks equipment from registration to end-of-life with maintenance history, depreciation and parts-used traceability. Inspection Management allows scheduling, assigning, conducting and reporting of inspections on mobile or desktop with image-backed findings, and a dedicated Non-Destructive Testing module supports UT, RT, MT and PT workflows with acceptance-criteria validation and QR-verified certificates. Job Management tracks delegated jobs to documented completion, Maintenance issues preventive schedules and alerts, a Financial Portal covers sales, purchases, banking and a full accountant suite, a Client Portal gives clients read-only access to their assets and reports, and an Offline Sync feature allows field data capture without connectivity.

items.description:
Autocosmosbiz, trading through the Electrolog platform in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria West, operates a subscription-based online electronic catalogue dedicated to the auto electrical industry. The platform brings together a complete and continuously updated database of auto electrical units, parts, accessories and components in a single system. It is designed to serve auto electricians, mechanics, suppliers, wholesalers and retailers by giving them fast, reliable access to accurate product information instead of requiring searches across multiple sources.

Subscribers can browse, search and compare products within the platform, including searching parts by part number, supplier, OE or manufacturer number, by measurements, or by engine or vehicle type. The catalogue also offers comprehensive bill-of-materials lists for units, allowing users to see all subcomponents and the units they fit, and lets subscribers compare up to ten items at once or search by keyword.

items.description:
Baldrcon Group, operating from Boardwalk Lakeside Suites in Faerie Glen, is a construction company working across commercial, residential, industrial and turnkey property development projects. The company positions itself as a guide through the common challenges of property development, including navigating property regulations and permits, finding trustworthy contractors and construction teams, managing costs and budgets, ensuring quality and timely completion, and adapting to unforeseen changes during a build. It draws on more than 25 years of combined experience in property development among its team.

Baldrcon describes a structured process for clients: an initial inquiry and consultation stage to understand a client's vision and requirements, followed by a budgeting and proposal creation stage that includes tendering. The company's listed service areas cover commercial, residential and industrial construction work as well as turnkey solutions for property development.

Baroque Real Estate is a property agency based at The Els Club within Copperleaf Golf & Country Estate in Centurion, describing itself as the trusted specialist agency at the estate for more than a decade. The agency positions property transactions as more than a sale, framing them as personal milestones and investments, and says it guides clients buying or selling with professionalism, integrity and genuine care. It combines local insight of the Copperleaf estate with strategic marketing and negotiation skills aimed at achieving strong results for clients.

Baroque Real Estate assists clients in listing a property for sale, finding a next home, or browsing current listings within a signature properties collection, supported by a team of property specialists and a resource library of property guides for buyers and sellers.

items.description:
BHL&J Dienste is a steel and metal products manufacturer based in East Lynne, Pretoria, established in 1990 and trading since 1993. With 31 years of expertise in the industry, the company positions itself as a leading manufacturer and supplier of steel and metal products for both domestic and commercial applications.

BHL&J Dienste operates as a fencing fabrication facility, specialising in crafting and supplying a diverse range of custom steel and fencing solutions tailored to customer requirements. The company emphasises quality assurance throughout its work, stating that meeting high industry standards is central to everything it does, and that its team's years of experience allow it to understand the particular requirements of different projects and industries across both residential and commercial steel and fencing applications.

Biddulphs International is a moving company established in 1928 and based at the N4 Gateway Industrial Park in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, describing itself as the largest independent moving company in South Africa with 13 branches nationwide. The company is accredited by FIDI FAIM Plus and is a member of IAM and BAR, and reports having completed around 500,000 international moves and 3 million domestic moves.

Its services include local moving for homes of any size, long-distance moving with savings of up to 33% when booked in off-peak periods, and international moving that covers land, sea and air freight for global relocations. Biddulphs also offers business and office relocation services designed to minimise disruption, commercial distribution logistics tailored to a client's operating needs, and storage solutions including classic storage and self-storage options.

Bite Pharma (Pty) Ltd is a South African pharmaceutical consultancy based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, established in 2019 as a small consultancy aimed at giving starting pharmaceutical companies access to decades of regulatory and sales experience. The company offers cost-effective project and licensing solutions aimed at small pharmaceutical businesses that cannot afford to appoint their own responsible pharmacist or full-time regulatory staff, emphasising a focused, direct approach and industry networking for its clients. Bite Pharma says it follows South African legislation and Section 22 registered pharmaceutical company requirements, drawing on a team of pharmacists with experience spanning medicine registration, product launches and new business development.

Its listed services include branding and rebranding, regulatory and compliance support, design of product and promotional materials, social media marketing, new business development and content marketing. Since the Covid-19 pandemic, the company has operated on a work-from-home basis, running meetings through web-hosted conferencing.

Bizco Consulting is a business consulting, mentoring and coaching firm based on Brooks Street in Menlo Park, Pretoria, offering tailored consulting aimed at addressing a client's specific challenges and driving sustainable growth. The firm reports having completed more than 2,000 projects for over 2,000 customers and having received 12 awards.

Bizco structures its core business-plan offering into tiers: a Bronze plan for businesses valued up to R10 million delivered within 5 working days, a Silver plan for up to R50 million delivered within 7 working days, a Gold plan for up to R100 million delivered within 10 working days, and a Platinum plan for businesses above R100 million delivered within 14 to 21 working days. Beyond business planning, its services include operational efficiency improvement, performance monitoring and evaluation, financial management, and risk management and compliance support.

BizConSA, based in Amberfield Valley, operates an online marketplace where South Africans can find and hire professional service providers such as mechanics, electricians, plumbers, nannies, tutors and lawyers. Service providers, referred to as Pros on the platform, register and build a business profile that can include their experience, past projects, reviews, testimonials, images, videos and location, with each business verified by BizConSA before being listed. Pros can also use the platform to sell services and products, create special offers, post updates on a wall page, and manage a booking calendar for their availability.

Clients looking for help can engage a Pro in one of several ways: requesting a quote for a service, buying a service directly through BizConSA's service store from a preferred business, or booking a service appointment directly through the platform.

Black House Realty is an estate agency operating from Brooklands Lifestyle Estate in Kosmosdal, Centurion, catering to people looking to buy or rent residential property. Listings handled by the agency at the time of research spanned a range of Gauteng suburbs, including a two-bedroom apartment in Northcliff, Randburg, apartments and a duplex in Linbro Park and Paulshof in Sandton, an apartment in Fourways, Sandton, and houses and townhouses within Thatch Hill Estate and Kosmos View Estate in Centurion.

The properties marketed by the agency have included two- and three-bedroom apartments, townhouses and duplexes, as well as a free-standing house, reflecting a focus on residential sales across these areas. Black House Realty's offering centres on helping clients find and secure homes across these Gauteng suburbs.

items.description:
Blue Core Logistics, based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, was established in January 2007 to provide container and customs inspection services within a variety of industries, and has since grown into a South African company offering logistics solutions with a worldwide reach. The company provides a comprehensive suite of end-to-end outsourced logistics solutions covering supply chain, freight, transport and personnel needs, built around long-term partnerships and bespoke service offerings tailored to individual client requirements.

In addition to its core logistics suite, Blue Core Logistics offers risk management, organisational design and human resources solutions, giving clients control over operational aspects beyond transport alone. Its services are organised around value-added services, transportation, sea freight, air freight and supply chain management, positioning the company to support clients regardless of the size of their business or where they operate.

items.description:
This Meyerspark business operates as Boxfresh Technologies, providing technology solutions spanning VoIP, fibre and wireless internet, CCTV, biometrics, telecom systems and office automation. Its VoIP offering covers cloud phone systems and hosted PBX for professional business calling, while its fibre internet service is aimed at fast, stable connectivity for homes and businesses, supplemented by wireless internet for locations where fibre is limited or unavailable. Office automation services cover printers, copiers and workflow solutions for modern offices, and its telecom systems division supports PBX, switchboards and wider telecom infrastructure.

On the security side, the company installs CCTV systems with remote monitoring and surveillance, along with biometric solutions for fingerprint-based access and attendance control, and offers managed WiFi coverage for offices, warehouses and homes. The business groups these offerings under the broad themes of connectivity, communication and security.

Boremo Management Consulting is a management consulting firm based in Akasia, Pretoria, that applies scientifically based approaches and human resource management techniques aimed at maximising individual, team and organisational effectiveness. The company describes its vision as becoming the preferred firm in developing and advancing organisations across Africa toward excellence, and its mission as providing organisations with business solutions that help them deal with their particular complexities and uncertainties so that they can excel in business performance. Boremo frames its consulting approach around themes such as creating a healthy work environment, nurturing employee growth, and maximising team effectiveness, positioning organisational development and human resource management as central tools for helping client organisations stand out and improve their overall performance.

Boxcraft, based on Stormvoël Road in Jan Niemand Park, Silverton, manufactures custom and stock cardboard boxes, including die-cut and printed packaging, alongside a range of general packaging supplies. Bespoke boxes are designed to a customer's specific requirements with no minimum order, catering to small production runs as well as larger orders, and can be produced as single or double walled, fluted or plain, in various sizes, with options for branding, logos and single or multicoloured printing. The company also stocks ready-made boxes in standard sizes as well as bin boxes, and supplies a wider range of packaging materials including bubble wrap, pallet wrap, sellotape, handy wrap, mini grip bags, plastic bags, Aerothene, SFK cardboard rolls, corner guards and strapping.

Boxcraft describes itself as offering competitive, outside-the-box packaging solutions for both businesses and individual consumers.

items.description:
This Garsfontein store trades as Bril Ateljee, the Pretoria branch of the Bril chain, which also operates stores in Durbanville, George, Paarl and Stellenbosch. The store sells sunglasses across several ranges, including a staff-picks collection such as the Filosoof, Nonchalant, Zeva, Ray, Ember and Chime styles, and an active collection including the OC Tankwa, OC Mont Blanc, OC Moab and OC Kona models.

Alongside eyewear, Bril has introduced Bril Audiology at its stores, offering a free hearing screening that customers can book, and sells a small accessory called Gripp, designed to keep glasses securely in place throughout the day. The store also runs a Bril Kids Club membership, which covers the cost of replacing children's lost or broken glasses and keeping up with their changing prescriptions for an annual membership fee.

Browns is a fine jewellery boutique at Shop 260 in Centurion Mall, part of a retailer built around a commitment to natural diamonds that traces its history back to 1934. The Centurion Mall store is open seven days a week, from 9am to 7pm Monday to Thursday and on Saturday, 9am to 8pm on Friday, and 9am to 4pm on Sunday.

Browns sells fine jewellery including bracelets, earrings and necklaces alongside its core diamond jewellery offering, and promotes what it calls The Browns Difference as part of its approach to natural diamonds. The brand also operates a loyalty club for customers, offers a jewellery care plan, and highlights its own sustainability commitments as part of its brand positioning, alongside a long-running collectible promotion known as The Browns Teddy Bear.

BSc Ignite Agency, based in Centurion Central, positions itself as a business growth partner offering human-centred coaching, smart automation and media solutions to help businesses scale with confidence. Its core offering is a single platform intended to replace the six to ten separate tools many businesses juggle to manage client relationships, marketing and payments, bringing dashboard reporting, conversations, sales opportunities, payments, marketing automation, website building, membership management, online reputation management and an app marketplace together under one login. The agency markets this platform as requiring no contract and allowing clients to cancel at any time, framing the value proposition around reducing the time businesses spend switching between separate subscriptions so they can focus more on revenue-generating activity such as closing deals rather than administrative tool management.

Build it Koedoespoort is a hardware and building materials store in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, part of the nationwide Build It group of independently owned builder's merchants. The store positions itself as a full-service builder's merchant offering expert advice and product ranges covering building materials, roofing and tools for home building and renovation projects, along with a delivery service to ease the burden of transporting materials to a building site.

Build it Koedoespoort also offers a range of in-store services to assist customers with building and decorating projects, and customers can apply for credit through finance partners including Evolution Finance, Kanga Finance, FIN, RCS and Capitec to help fund their projects. The store also participates in the Build it Rewards programme, and the Build It group operates on an ownership model under which store owners can join the Build It family as an independent franchise.

Bundubeard is a Pretoria-based online retailer of traditional wet-shaving products, based in Donkerhoek, aimed at South African men ranging from cash-strapped students to dedicated shaving connoisseurs. Its range includes safety razors, straight razors, sheep's tallow shaving soaps and both vintage and handmade shaving brushes, with examples of stocked products including an Oryx razor fitted with a G7 blade, an Oryx James Oryx II razor, Ever-ready 100 and Culmak Junior vintage brushes, and a Bundu-branded shaving set.

Beyond retail, Bundubeard also offers a razor-sharpening service for customers wanting to maintain their existing blades rather than replace them. The business frames itself around a steel-beats-stubble philosophy, encouraging a return to traditional, reusable shaving tools over disposable alternatives.

cablElec is an electrical cable, lighting and accessories supplier based in Sinoville, Pretoria, established to service the mining, industrial, agricultural, automotive, security and building industries as well as individual customers. The company stocks a full range of electrical cable, lighting and accessory products and can supply any available product within 24 hours, with key accounts given round-the-clock access to products for emergency situations.

cablElec's capabilities span residential, commercial and industrial electrical supply, and it stocks all major brands at what it describes as excellent prices. The company says it tenders with customers to secure the best price for the quantities they need and buys in bulk so that those savings can be passed on, positioning itself around a combination of broad stock availability, fast turnaround and competitive pricing for trade and individual buyers alike.

items.description: Cbee Electrical is an electrical contracting business offering installation, repair and maintenance services for homes and businesses, with its main areas of specialisation covering Waterkloof, Rietfontein, Pretoria, Midrand and Centurion. The company operates a 24/7 electrician call-out service and says its team of licensed electricians is highly skilled and experienced across all aspects of electrical work, with ongoing investment in training and education intended to keep the team current with newer electrical technologies and techniques. Alongside general electrical installation and repair work, Cbee Electrical also offers solar system services, extending its offering from traditional electrical contracting into renewable energy installations for residential and commercial clients in the greater Pretoria area.

This Cellucity store in The Grove Mall, Equestria, is part of a South African mobile phone retail chain that markets itself around 30 years of experience in the sector. The store sells smartphones from brands including Samsung, Apple, Huawei, Honor and Oppo, alongside accessories from brands such as Baseus, Boompods, Energea, Joyroom, Sennheiser, Sudio and Tucano.

Cellucity positions itself around helping customers either upgrade an existing Vodacom contract or buy unlocked smartphones and accessories for cash, and it also offers a pre-owned device range alongside new stock. Trade-in offers are available on selected new devices, allowing customers to offset the cost of an upgrade by trading in a supported existing device, reflecting the chain's broader focus on both contract upgrades and outright smartphone and accessory purchases for South African customers.

items.description:
CGS Corporate Group Services is a Pretoria-headquartered security provider with satellite offices in Midrand and Alrode, built on more than 25 years of operating experience across most segments of the security market. The company's shareholders collectively bring more than 50 years of experience within the local security industry, and CGS is accredited with a Level 2 B-BBEE rating.

Describing itself as a medium-sized business, CGS says it has earned the respect of competitors in its field, and its team works closely with clients to provide security solutions tailored to their needs. While headquartered in Pretoria and covering the greater Gauteng area from its Midrand and Alrode offices, the company is also fully operational in KwaZulu-Natal, Port Elizabeth and Cape Town, and says it is working to extend its footprint to a national scale.

Chamberlain Waltloo, on Zasm Street in Waltloo, Pretoria, is a branch of the Chamberlain hardware, paint and building supplies chain. The store stocks a broad range of categories including ironmongery, fasteners, boards and timber, building materials, builders' site equipment, plumbing supplies, paint and adhesives, garden and outdoor living products, power tools, hand tools, lighting and electrical goods, doors, frames and openings, décor items, hobby supplies, mouldings, and safety and security products.

Its paint range includes major brands such as Duram, Dulux and Plascon, spanning finishes from roof coatings and acrylic PVA to double-velvet and cashmere sheens, weatherguard exterior paint and micatex textured coatings, available in a variety of sheens and textures from fine and medium texture to low sheen and matt finishes. The store also offers paint tester pots and tinting services, and runs a trade card promotion for regular customers.

Charis Business Concepts (CBC) is a business advisory and consulting firm established in 2014 and based in the Waterkloof Park area of Pretoria, staffed by cost and management accountants who are members of the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants. The firm positions itself around strategic advisory work, operational excellence and sustainable growth, aiming to add measurable value for clients by focusing on the core operations that drive revenue and asking the questions that lead to institutional efficiency and long-term profitability.

Charis Business Concepts specialises in management solutions with a primary focus on operational efficiency and strategic cost management, refining internal structures and workflows so businesses can maximise growth potential while maintaining cost-effective management standards. Its core services include operations optimisation, risk management, cost and costing analysis, structural organisation, capacity auditing to evaluate resource allocation for scalability, and process innovation and re-engineering aimed at modernising legacy systems.

Cheers Restaurant is a family-run, aviation-inspired restaurant based in the Ryneveld Lifestyle Centre in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, aimed at bringing family and friends together over a meal. The restaurant describes its food as made with fresh ingredients, served within a casual, hospitable setting, and builds its identity around the saying where friends meet.

Beyond its everyday dining offering, Cheers Restaurant promotes daily specials and events through its Facebook page, inviting customers to follow along for updates on what is on offer. The restaurant's aviation theme runs through its branding and atmosphere, positioning it as a relaxed, welcoming spot for regular visits with family and friends rather than a formal dining destination for special occasions only, consistent with its own description of itself as a neighbourhood gathering place.

Chem Supplies is a manufacturer of specialised cleaning chemicals based in the Hermanstad Business Park in Pretoria, describing a legacy spanning three decades in the chemical industry. The company is ISO 9001 certified and a member of the NCCA, and offers disinfectant and food-safe product ranges intended for compliance and audit purposes, with bulk savings available to NCCA members and contract cleaning or facility management companies.

Chem Supplies serves a range of industries including automotive and carwash, hygiene and sanitation, household and office, industrial, and consumables and equipment sectors. Among its featured products are a leather conditioner, a heavy-duty degreaser, an economy dishwashing liquid, and a blue shampoo product, reflecting a product range spanning both household cleaning and more specialised industrial and automotive chemical needs.

Chery Pretoria, on Steve Biko Road in Gezina, is a dealership for the Chery brand offering the marque's full Tiggo model range. This spans compact models such as the Tiggo 4 Cross and its hybrid Tiggo 4 Cross HEV variant, through the mid-range Tiggo 7, Tiggo 7 PHEV and Tiggo 7 Pro, up to the larger Tiggo 8 Apex, Tiggo 8 PHEV, Tiggo 8 Pro LS and Tiggo 8 Pro Max models, and the flagship Tiggo 9 and Tiggo 9 PHEV.

The dealership promotes a digital ownership service allowing customers to manage features via a smartphone app on Android, Huawei or Apple devices. Chery Pretoria's offering centres on new vehicle sales across this plug-in hybrid and conventional petrol model line-up alongside the brand's wider dealer services.

Chinex Photography, trading as Chinex Productions, is a Moregloed-based photography and media business that has been operating since 2016, describing its purpose as capturing real life and memories worth keeping forever. The business covers a range of occasions including birthdays, weddings, corporate events and studio photography, with its team offering photography, livestreaming and musical video production depending on a client's needs.

For couples, Chinex Productions emphasises wedding photography created by a team it describes as well-trained, skilled, creative and highly professional, aimed at capturing a wedding day with taste. The business also offers portrait and portfolio photography sessions available by appointment, giving individual clients the chance to get their own professionally shot portfolio images alongside the event and wedding photography services that form its core offering.

items.description:
Clean Bright Cleaning Service offers residential and office cleaning across Pretoria North and surrounding areas, including Doornpoort, operating by appointment only. Its core service, performed at every visit, covers bathrooms (tile walls, tubs, showers, vanities, mirrors, chrome fixtures, toilets and steam cleaning), sleeping and office areas (dusting of surfaces, ceiling fans, lamps, window sills and blinds, plus vacuuming of all floors), kitchens and breakrooms (counter tops, range hoods, appliance fronts, sinks, microwaves and floor maintenance), and living and general areas (detailed dusting, vacuuming and spot cleaning of doors and frames), with professional ironing included for regular and contract clients. On a rotating basis, the company also carries out deeper maintenance cleaning, including scrubbing bathroom tile grout, cleaning of drains and faucets, deep cabinet care, hand-wiping of baseboards, vacuuming of upholstery, cleaning under furniture and desks, and more detailed appliance and carpet care.

The business operates Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 17:00, with Saturdays reserved for once-off cleaning bookings only.

This East Lynne branch of Cleaning Warehouse sells a range of household and industrial cleaning products under the company's JiM Extreme brand, marketed as a gold-standard cleaning line. The product range on offer includes dishwashing liquid, an air fryer cleaner, auto dishwasher rinse aid and dishwasher salt, a bathroom cleaner, a black fluid cleaning product, thick and thin bleach, a brass polish called Brass Glo, and lavender- and lemon-scented hand creams, with most lines available in single units or packs of six. The branch forms part of Cleaning Warehouse's presence in Pretoria, giving customers in the East Lynne area access to this in-house branded range of detergents and cleaning products for both household and more industrial cleaning needs, supporting everyday domestic cleaning as well as larger-scale or contract cleaning use.

Clearance Co. is a discounted furniture and homeware store at 904 Haarlem Street in Hermanstad, Pretoria, offering a wide range of styles and practical pieces suited to any room in the home. Customers can shop in-store or arrange in-store pickup, with both credit and debit card payments accepted, and staff are available to help customers find pieces to suit their needs.

Alongside its furniture and homeware range, Clearance Co. also provides an eco-friendly recycling service for batteries, electronics and ink cartridges, giving customers a way to dispose of these items responsibly while shopping for new or discounted pieces. The store's premises include wheelchair-accessible parking, supporting easier access for customers visiting the Hermanstad showroom in person.

items.description: Connect Mobile, based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, is an enterprise mobile messaging and connectivity company offering what it describes as more than messaging: a connected communication stack bringing together mobile messaging, customer engagement, campaign management, secure connectivity and rewards under one provider. Its core services include Bulk SMS for high-volume alerts, marketing campaigns, reminders and customer notifications, USSD for interactive mobile journeys such as surveys, competitions, account flows and self-service, Short Codes for simple response channels covering lead capture, voting, opt-ins and two-way engagement, and Branded Messages, which give businesses a recognisable, brand-led sender identity intended to build customer trust. Connect Mobile positions its infrastructure as reliable enough to carry access-critical messages such as one-time passwords and alerts, and also offers additional products including automated messaging tools, alongside partnership opportunities for businesses wanting to become a licensee of its platform.

Consultium Group is a business compliance and registration services firm based in Brooklyn, Pretoria, helping founders, growing SMEs and established companies stay compliant with CIPC, SARS and B-BBEE requirements. Its services include registering private companies (Pty Ltd), appointing a Public Officer, filing annual returns, and updating company directors and shareholders, alongside tax clearance status pin applications, VAT registrations, and PAYE and UIF onboarding for new employers.

Consultium Group also prepares B-BBEE affidavits for exempted micro enterprises, and separately offers support for ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification, as well as marketing, branding and digital services for clients who need more than compliance support alone. The firm operates by appointment only, with business hours from Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00, and is closed on weekends and public holidays.
